text: I must go home.” “Not until I have applied some strips of plaster, and you have rested a little.” She sat down hastily, without another word, and allowed it to be bound up. “Now, if you please,” said she, “I must go. Mamma will not see it, I think. It is under the hair, is it not?” “Quite; no one could tell.” “But you must not go,” said Mrs. Thornton, impatiently. “You are not fit to go.” “I must,” said Margaret, decidedly.
